channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Komoot launches ChatGPT app to provide instant AI-powered route planning via “natural language prompts”
item.description: Outdoor navigation platform Komoot has unveiled new ChatGPT integration that lets you discover tailored routes using simple text prompts, and send them straight to the Komoot app

item.title: It’s February, I’ve just bought a short-sleeve jersey… and it’s the best decision I’ve made for a long time
item.description: Yep, you're reading this right... George Hill has some positive things to say for a change

item.title: “But why aren’t cyclists in the cycle lane?”: London rider stunned by this “awesome infrastructure” closed at one end… and blocked by a van at the other + more on the live blog
item.description: What's o-curling? Sorry, Dan Alexander heard the Winter Olympics commentator drop that in last night and is looking for any excuse to use it... yes, he is aware it's got nothing to do with cycling or Thursday's live blog...

item.title: Gaerne G.Ice-Storm Road 1.0 Gore-Tex Black
item.description: Impressive waterproofing and warmth, though sole flex can be an issue for those putting the power down

item.title: The 60-year-old cyclist in training to ride every stage of the Tour de France after a hip replacement and leukaemia diagnosis
item.description: Despite plenty of hurdles, David Stoyle is taking on one of the biggest challenges in all of cycling. We spoke to David about his planning and preparation for the huge event

item.title: The ultimate bike industry boom and bust disaster story? Private equity firm that invested huge sums in Raleigh’s parent company has lost over £1 billion
item.description: Accell, which also owns Lapierre, Babboe, and a host of other bike and e-bike brands, says it has secured new financial backing as part of its latest restructuring process, which it claims will “fundamentally transform the business”

item.title: The fitness tech boom continues: Garmin reports record revenue for 2025
item.description: “Looking forward, we anticipate building on this momentum with many exciting new product launches throughout the year,” the company’s president and CEO Cliff Pemble said

item.title: “Driving a bus is difficult enough”: Bus drivers’ union says mandatory hi-vis jackets for cyclists would “make roads a safer place” and hits out at “poor visibility” of people on bikes
item.description: Ireland’s National Bus and Rail Union told parliament that issues on the roads have increased due to the “proliferation of faster vehicles, electric scooters, and electric bikes”

item.title: Fizik brings back the Arione… but did it ever go away?
item.description: Still nearly a foot long, the Arione is reworked with modern materials – including models with 3D-printed padding – with prices from £99.99

item.title: “Cheating will be part of cycling forever”: MPCC president Emily Brammeier on anti-doping, tackling the ‘grey area’, and making clean sport the norm
item.description: “The cycling fan in me, the little girl in me, wants to say we will have a clean sport one day, but you have to be realistic. It’s human nature”
